newsitem.title: CHINA: Flood hits early rice output in southern China.
newsitem.headline: Flood hits early rice output in southern China.

text.p: Early rice output in China's southern Guangdong province was expected to be lower than the forecast of 9.1 million tonnes due to recent floods, officials said on Wednesday.
"The early rice output certainly cannot reach 9.1 million tonnes because of the flood," an official of the Guangdong provincial agriculture department said in a telephone interview.
He declined to give further details.
A total of 211,680 hectares of crops had been affected by floods this month, said an official from the local flood control office without elaborating.
Floods killed at least 41 people this month in southern Guangdong and affected 3.26 million residents, including tens of thousands who were left homeless, officials had said.
